column1: # Proto-Elamite tentative phonetic readings: sign code (base or exact) -> syllable value.
# This is the READING layer, separate from graphic allography
# (proto-elamite-allographs.tsv): several distinct signs can share one
# syllable value (homophony, like Sumerian KUR mountain/land/slave), and
# each sign keeps its own logographic meaning in the `meaning` column.
# Codes given as a base number (M380) cover all its ~x/@x variants.
